name: reel-008-move-transact-save
source: marketing/handoff/inbox/008-sui-lagos-payments-content (DRAFTS.md section 3, drafted by Claude for Muse's job 008; Stalanic chose the Reel first and to keep Sui in, 2026-10-01)
script_changes: Hook: 'doesn't have an app' -> 'has no app' (shorter, lands harder in the first 3 s).
The narrator now speaks the three words ('Move. Transact. Save.'); the draft only showed them. Tayo's own line is 'Move, transact, save. That is financial freedom.'
Dropped 'His company has spent seventeen years building new ways to move money' and the place names from the voice to fit 30-45 s; LAGOS / CAMEROON / GHANA stay on screen under the names.
'It runs on trust, with one weak spot' -> 'The catch:'; 'Not the organizer. Not us.' -> 'Not even us.' (same claim, shorter).

voice.direction: Deep, warm documentary voice, the same narrator as Circles of the World, a touch brisker for a short Reel: around 140 words per minute. Confident but never hypey. Heritage documentary trailer, not a commercial. Minimal processing, natural room tone.
voice.pronunciation: Sui = swee (one syllable, rhymes with 'we'); Paga = PAH-gah; Tayo = TAH-yoh; Oviosu = oh-vee-oh-soo (four even syllables, pure vowels); esusu = eh-SOO-soo; njangi = n-JAHN-gee; susu = SOO-soo; Njangi On-Chain = n-JAHN-gee on-chain; save = SAYV (end on a clearly voiced v)
voice.whisper_hint: Sui Live. Paga. Tayo Oviosu. Esusu. Njangi. Susu. Njangi On-Chain.

params.eyebrow: TAYO OVIOSU · PAGA · SUI LIVE, MIAMI 2026

scenes.headline: Africa’s original savings app has *no app.*
scenes.vo: Africa’s original savings app | has no app.
scenes.delivery: intriguing and quiet, a small knowing smile on 'has no app'

scenes.headline: Move. Transact. *Save.*
scenes.vo: At Sui Live, | Paga’s founder Tayo Oviosu said | financial freedom is three things. | Move. | Transact. | Save.
scenes.delivery: informative, then let each of the three words land on its own with a short pause before it; 'save' the warmest

scenes.headline: Esusu · Njangi · Susu
scenes.vo: The saving part, | communities built long ago: | esusu, | njangi, | susu.
scenes.delivery: warm and proud, unhurried; a small lift on each name

scenes.headline: *Everyone* pays in. / One takes *the pot.* / It goes *round.*
scenes.vo: Everyone pays in. | One takes the pot. | It goes round.
scenes.delivery: crisp and rhythmic, three clean beats

scenes.headline:
*The catch:*
somebody holds the pot.
scenes.vo: The catch: | somebody has to hold the pot.
scenes.delivery: tension, slow down on the last words

scenes.headline: *Nobody* holds the pot.
scenes.vo: We kept the circle | and changed one thing. | Nobody holds the pot. | Not even us.
scenes.delivery: confident lift, peak conviction on 'nobody holds the pot', then a settled, quiet 'not even us'

scenes.vo: Njangi On-Chain. | The same circle, | with less friction.

phone.prompt: Minimal and modern: a single soft sustained pad with sparse felt piano notes, quiet, curious, intimate, D major

triad.prompt: Forward motion building: pulsing low strings and kora arpeggios gathering pace, a soft talking drum pulse, cinematic and purposeful

heritage.prompt: Warm kora melody with felt piano and sustained strings, West African heritage, proud and tender

mechanic.prompt: Calm steady kora ostinato with a soft talking drum and shaker pulse, felt piano chords, clear and light

caption_breaks: ' | ' in a scene's vo marks a caption break. The markers are stripped before TTS and Whisper QA.
